correlations.title: External Service Identity Ingress & API Session Binding
correlations.explanation: Authentication log A011 confirms svc_rollcall authenticated from external IP 203.0.113.77 using API_KEY. Subsequent Gateway requests R003-R006 originated from the exact same source IP under client rollcall-prod.

correlations.title: API Gateway to Backend Portal Execution Duality
correlations.explanation: Each gateway HTTP call maps directly to an application-level audit event in ClassBridge within 0-2 seconds, confirming the gateway forwarded requests without backend authorization barriers.

correlations.title: Credential Configuration Inspection Preceding Data Acquisition
correlations.explanation: CHG-882 records svc_rollcall invoking credential_config_read on integration_settings/rollcall. Exactly 5 seconds later, R003 executed a bulk learner search. Strongly supports credential verification or endpoint reconnaissance.

correlations.title: Learner Data Export Staging to Cloud Repository Exfiltration Pipeline
correlations.explanation: The API export request R004 spawned export job CHG-883, writing 486,200 bytes to CampusVault (C001). Actor svc_rollcall subsequently listed the export bucket (C002) and executed two separate GET downloads (C003, C004) totaling 972,400 bytes.

correlations.title: Network Perimeter Anomaly & Connector Resumption
correlations.explanation: First connection from unrecognized IP 203.0.113.77 observed at 03:15:55. Anomalous activity ceased after C004 (03:24:48). At 03:25:00, legitimate connector node 10.10.4.12 resumed scheduled operations.

correlations.title: Architectural Privilege Creep Violation (Least Privilege Failure)
correlations.explanation: INT-01 register documents purpose as strictly 'Attendance synchronization'. However, assigned scopes included learner.search and learner.export. This allowed the compromised or abused credential to dump sensitive student PII.

correlations.title: Unauthorized Operational Activity Confirmed by Business Stakeholders
correlations.explanation: HD-1062 confirms planned maintenance had 'No bulk export planned'. HD-1069 confirms Finance never authorized the export. VND-221 confirms RollCall vendor initiated no export. The export was entirely unauthorized.

correlations.title: Potential Credential Exposure via Support Channel Artifact
correlations.explanation: Ticket HD-1058 notes an admin provided a settings panel screenshot to vendor support on Oct 9. Policy E08 strictly forbids credentials in screenshots/tickets. Exposure is under vendor review. It is a plausible vector but NOT definitively proven as the sole leak source.

correlations.title: Dormant Terminated Account Authentication Violation (Offboarding Failure)
correlations.explanation: Former employee former.ajay successfully authenticated 9 days post-termination, directly violating E08 Section 8.2. IMPORTANT: There is NO evidence connecting Ajay to the RollCall incident; this is cataloged as a distinct identity lifecycle deficiency.

unified_incident_timeline.forensic_assessment: First connection from unrecognized external IP 203.0.113.77 to Gateway.
Third-party machine identity authenticates using static API key rc-prod-01 without MFA.
Integration settings inspected via API exactly 5 seconds before scraping operations commenced.
Unthrottled bulk query returns 2,300 learner records in a single query. Latency: 3,250ms.
Mass export invoked. Core portal responsiveness spikes to 8,420ms due to unindexed database scan.
Worker writes learners-20261012.csv (486,200 bytes) containing 2,300 learner records to cloud bucket.
Adversary lists repository bucket contents to locate staged export.
First download of export file (486,200 bytes transferred to external IP).
Second download of export file (486,200 bytes). Cumulative egress: 972,400 bytes.
Legitimate RollCall connector resumes regular heartbeat and attendance synchronization.
Independent offboarding deficiency 9 days post-termination; no evidentiary link to RollCall breach.
